doc:
# Matrix Model — JTGravity

Unformalized claims gathered verbatim from [wiphy.org](https://wiphy.org/) (query: “matrix model JT gravity”).

claims.name: colored_jackiwteitelboim_jt_gravity_twodimensional
claims.statement: Colored Jackiw-Teitelboim (JT) gravity is the two-dimensional dilaton gravity model with matrix-valued fields.

claims.name: refined_nyi_negativity_defined_within
claims.statement: The refined Rényi negativity is defined within the matrix model of Jackiw-Teitelboim (JT) gravity.

sources.title: Negativity and its capacity in JT gravity

claims.name: two_models_particular_note_jt
claims.statement: Two models of particular note are the JT supergravity theory defined as a (1,2) Altland-Zirnbauer matrix ensemble and the Saad-Shenker-Stanford matrix model of ordinary JT gravity.

sources.title: Low Energy Thermodynamics of JT Gravity and Supergravity

claims.name: full_nonperturbative_physics_jt_gravity
claims.statement: The full non-perturbative physics of JT gravity can be extracted using double-scaled matrix model definitions.

sources.title: Explorations of Non-Perturbative JT Gravity and Supergravity

claims.name: higher_genus_corrections_eigenvalue_density
claims.statement: Higher genus corrections to the eigenvalue density of JT gravity are computed using hermitian matrix model techniques.

sources.title: Resurgence in the Virasoro Minimal String and 3d Gravity

claims.name: bosonic_virasoro_minimal_string_relates
claims.statement: The (bosonic) Virasoro minimal string relates worldsheet string theory to a deformation of the JT gravity matrix model.

sources.title: Towards the super Virasoro minimal string

claims.name: duality_between_jt_gravity_doublescaled
claims.statement: The duality between JT gravity and the double-scaled matrix model can be studied together with their respective deformations.

sources.title: Deformations of JT Gravity via Topological Gravity and Applications

claims.name: genus_expansion_de_sitter_jt
claims.statement: The genus expansion of de Sitter JT gravity coincides with the genus expansion of observables in a double-scaled matrix model, with the matrix model providing a non-perturbative completion.

claims.name: large_random_matrix_model_framework
claims.statement: A large $N$ random matrix model framework is examined as a route beyond the ordinary JT gravity topological expansion to non-perturbative physics.

sources.title: Consistency Conditions for Non-Perturbative Completions of JT Gravity

claims.name: correspondence_between_jt_gravity_dual
claims.statement: The correspondence between JT gravity and its dual matrix-model description is sharpened at finite radial cutoff $\lambda$ via the $ T\overline{T} $ deformation.

sources.title: $T\overline{T}$-deformed free energy of the Airy model

claims.name: continuous_spectrum_spectral_edge_randommatrix
claims.statement: The continuous spectrum at the spectral edge of the random-matrix theory (RMT) dual of Jackiw-Teitelboim (JT) gravity is universally described by the Airy model.

sources.title: Exploring the Spectral Edge in SYK Models

claims.name: paper_constructs_complex_matrix_model
claims.statement: The paper constructs a complex matrix model that provides a stable, unambiguous nonperturbative low-energy completion for Jackiw-Teitelboim (JT) gravity while preserving the correct high-energy perturbative physics. This formulation naturally incorporates spacetime features analogous to Ramond-Ramond fluxes and includes a deformation parameter that interpolates between this nonperturbative JT theory and super JT gravity.

claims.name: authors_generalize_saadshenkerstanford_duality_jt
claims.statement: The authors generalize the Saad-Shenker-Stanford duality to JT gravity coupled to higher spin fields, proposing a dual matrix model of $N - 1$ commuting matrices to account for deviations from conventional random matrix theory.

sources.title: Higher spin JT gravity and a matrix model dual

claims.name: lowestenergy_eigenvalue_distribution_quantumcompleted_jt
claims.statement: The lowest-energy eigenvalue distribution of quantum-completed JT gravity is fully described by a non-linear ordinary differential equation derived from a non-perturbative special random Hermitian matrix model.

sources.title: The Distribution of Ground State Energies in JT Gravity

claims.name: further_identifies_matrixmodel_dual_twodimensional
claims.statement: It further identifies a matrix-model dual for this two-dimensional string theory as a specific time-dependent background of $c=1$ matrix quantum mechanics, and extends the correspondence to the two-dimensional de-Sitter JT gravity case.

sources.title: JT Gravity Limit of Liouville CFT and Matrix Model

claims.name: abel_integral_equation_extra_confining
claims.statement: The Abel’s integral equation for the extra confining potential is identical to the string equation of the matrix model in the Saad-Shenker-Stanford (SSS) duality formulation of Jackiw-Teitelboim (JT) gravity.

sources.title: Discrete Bulk Spectrum in Jackiw-Teitelboim Theory

claims.name: article_argue_deformation_jt_gravity
claims.statement: In this article, we argue that a deformation of JT gravity with bulk action $ -\frac{1}{2}\int {\mathrm d}^2x \sqrt g(\phi R+W(\phi))$ is likewise dual to a matrix model.

sources.title: Matrix Models and Deformations of JT Gravity

claims.name: show_partition_function_jt_gravity
claims.statement: We show that the partition function of JT gravity is written as the expectation value of a macroscopic loop operator in the old matrix model of 2d gravity in the background where infinitely many couplings are turned on in a specific way.

sources.title: JT gravity, KdV equations and macroscopic loop operators
